versions.changelog:
Version 1.0.2 of Strategic Analyst is a no-code or content-only update.

- No file changes detected in this release.
- The SKILL.md documentation remains unchanged in both content and structure.
- All features and instructions are consistent with the previous version.

Version 1.0.1 — No file changes detected.

- No updates or modifications were made in this version.
- Functionality and documentation remain unchanged from the previous release.

- Initial release of the Strategic Analyst skill: a McKinsey-style assistant for systematic industry and market analysis.
- Supports requests for industry research, competitive assessments, investment decisions, and strategy frameworks (Porter's Five Forces, TAM-SAM-SOM, PESTEL, etc.).
- Integrated tools for structured data collection, framework-driven analysis, and dual-format (Markdown + HTML) report generation.
- Enforces data transparency, mandatory logging (`data_collection.md`), and automated quality review before report delivery.
- Requires Tavily API key for advanced data sourcing; WebSearch fallback available with limited depth.
- All outputs include source links, data credibility ratings, and research-standard formatting.
